units.name: metric horsepower
units.note: exact 75 kgf·m/s definition not stated on the fetched NIST pages

units.name: Mach (sea level, ISA 15°C)
units.note: no official definition; ISA sea-level speed of sound 340.294 m/s (ICAO/ISO 2533, not in allowed sources)

units.name: acre (international)

units.name: month (30 d)
units.note: no official month; 30 d convention (other: 365/12 d = 30.4167 d, 365.2425/12 d)

units.name: radians per second
units.note: SI Brochure warns frequency (Hz) and angular frequency (rad/s) must not be mixed

units.name: gallon (UK) per minute
sources: UK Weights and Measures Act 1985, Schedule 1

units.name: parts per million (mg/L in water)
units.note: ppm = mg/L only for dilute aqueous solutions (density 1 kg/L); SP 811 discourages ppm
